verdict.rationale: Pylon's Support Agent can be given runbooks, described as manuals for executing complex procedures. The issue log records the steps the AI takes, which points to multi-step handling rather than one canned answer. Nothing in the evidence shows the agent asking customers clarifying questions, and multi-step troubleshooting is only implied through runbook configuration. Missing for 10: documented clarifying-question behavior, explicit multi-turn troubleshooting flow docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, the agent asks clarifying questions and works through multi-step troubleshooting instead of dumping one canned answer

citations.quote: Give your agents manuals to execute complex procedures.
